scope: Bound caller-owned root NamedObjectsDictionary name/handle entry staging by row count and retained bytes.

countedPayload: entry name bytes plus one terminator
hex-handle string bytes plus one terminator

behavior: Const and move setters estimate row slots and both strings before copying or moving.
The const setter stages into a temporary and catches allocation failure. Rejected count, byte-budget or copy input clears stale entries and latches write refusal until corrected.
Rejected move input remains caller-owned. A corrected setter clears the rejection and supports same-codec retry.
A pending rejection is checked before output initialization, while writeObjects retains its defensive rejection check.
The existing NOD/group-plan freeze rule is preserved.

normalFocused.coverage: Exact and one-byte-under estimator boundaries, exact row-count acceptance, over-count const/move refusal, caller preservation and stale-state clearing, injected const-copy allocation failure/retry, ASCII/Binary write destination preservation and corrected same-writer retry, plus neighboring setter/no-raw controls.

limitations: The estimate covers logical vector slots and string payloads, not allocator capacity or process RSS.
This internal resource ceiling is not a DXF format maximum or support claim.
The root setter's out-of-line implementation requires downstream consumers to rebuild/relink; ABI and packaging qualification remain open under P8.
